```{r}
ds_patches %>%
  filter(trophic_type == "autotrophic",
         flow == "absolute") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = log(patch_size_ml),
             y = bioarea_per_volume,
             group = interaction(flow_ml, metaecosystem),
             fill = metaecosystem)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(
    x = x_axis_log_patch_size, 
    y = y_axis_patch_bioarea
  )
```
